jobDescription: Buyers on the consumer marketplace see listings in the order the search ranking models decide, and this engineer looks after those models once they leave the notebook. The job covers the release of ranking models to the production search service under a traffic ramp, the on-call duty for ranking incidents such as a feature store outage, the reading of the live relevance and conversion dashboards after each release, the release coordination with the search platform team, and the model card for each model. Reports to the head of search; works with the search platform team, data science and the marketplace product managers.
requirements: Releases ranking models to the production search service under a traffic ramp and reads the live relevance and conversion dashboards after each release.
Takes on-call duty for ranking incidents such as a feature store outage.
Coordinates each release with the search platform team and records which checks are own and which are the platform team's.
Evaluates ranking models offline against held-out interaction data under the agreed evaluation protocol.
Writes the model card for each model, including limitations and hand-over conditions.

evidence.text: Released five ranking models to the production search service of the marketplace between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp from one per cent to full traffic and each on a release ticket in my name.
Took on-call duty for ranking incidents throughout that period; the feature store outage of autumn 2024 was mine to handle, and the search incident log carries my incident record for it.

Read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release and in the weekly ranking review, and rolled one release back in 2024 when the conversion dashboard showed a regression on low-traffic categories.

Evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the evaluation protocol agreed with data science before it went to the release review with the search platform team, where the release ticket recorded which checks were mine.
Wrote the model card for each of the five models: training window, offline and post-release results, the known weakness on low-traffic categories, and what the next engineer needed to know.
Work sample: the five release tickets with their traffic ramp records, the search incident log record for the feature store outage and the weekly ranking review deck for the last quarter.

Recruiter screen: asked which of the five models she released herself, the candidate named all five with their release quarters and described the feature store outage; the quarters and the outage agree with the resume and the release tickets.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of search asks the packet to reference the release tickets and the incident record directly, and to keep the offline evaluation separate from the production releases when listing requirements.

propositions.text: The candidate released five ranking models to the production search service between 2023 and 2025, each under a traffic ramp and on a release ticket in her name.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the release tickets document the releases.

propositions.text: The candidate took on-call duty for ranking incidents, handled the feature store outage recorded in the search incident log, and read the live relevance and conversion dashboards after every release, rolling one release back on a conversion regression.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the incident record document the on-call duty, the outage and the dashboard reading.

propositions.text: The candidate evaluated every model offline against held-out interaction data under the agreed evaluation protocol, took each to the release review with the search platform team, and wrote the model card for each of the five models.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the evaluation, the release reviews and the model cards.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the production releases, the on-call duty, the outage and the model cards.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The production releases, on-call duty and incident handling are documented in the resume, the release tickets and the incident record; keep the environment as stated.
followUpTargets: Ask for the search incident log record of the feature store outage to confirm the date.
